title: RFC 9457 — 405 Method Not Allowed
description: Validates the RFC 9457 Problem Details structure for 405 Method Not Allowed responses. All five fields (type, title, status, detail, instance) are required. Can be reused by any test case that expects a 405 error response.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem

status.description: HTTP status code — must be 405 in the body (AC4)

instance.description: URI reference / request path that identifies this occurrence (AC5)
